anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.severity: material -- the reviewers should see this first
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: The measured D8 = 0.0043859313845401315 fires A1-PLATEAU under the frozen band (D8 >= 0.003214927) but is LESS THAN the unequal-size two-sample critical value 0.004780061 that the contract itself names.
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.why_it_matters: The contract asserts, in the_primary_rule_is_deliberately_calibration_robust and again in the approval's reasoning, that 'a PLATEAU outcome therefore rejects under BOTH calibrations'. That assertion is not exact for D8 values in [0.003214927, 0.004780061), and this run's value falls inside that interval. The label is calibration-robust as a LABEL, but the rejection is not: under the one-sample calibration the enlarged comparison rejects (2.75x the critical value), and under the unequal-size two-sample calibration it does not.
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.what_the_executor_did: Applied the frozen band exactly as written -- the label is A1-PLATEAU -- and reported the raw quantity and the gap rather than substituting a rule or reaching for a tiebreaker. No band was adjusted and no run was re-scored. Adjudicating the gap is the Reviewer's and Coordinator's work.

anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: DR-A1c's eight same-size block statistics against the fixed treatment CDF span 0.003272 to 0.006544 with median 0.004541. The frozen constant D_028 = 0.004808280332681103 ranks 4th of the nine descending and is NOT strictly the largest.
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.note: The contract fixes the smallest attainable p-value of this check at 1/9 = 0.1111, so it is a descriptive tie-aware calibration and never a test. Reported because the contract requires all nine values, their min/median/max and the rank. The measured block median 0.004541 sits close to the one-sample alpha=0.01 critical value 0.004506684668638803 at that n; the executor reports the numbers and offers no mechanism. D_028 enters only as a recorded constant in a NEW nine-way comparison defined by this contract, and BATCH-028's frozen verdict is untouched.

anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: The treatment REJECTS against the uniform block-0 null (D_TU = 0.005274584 > 0.004506685) and does NOT reject against its own support-matched null (D_TS = 0.002889555 < 0.004506685), while the two nulls are not distinguishable from each other at this n (D_SU = 0.004433708 <= 0.006373415).
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.note: The specific joint reading the contract pre-committed to report -- A2-SUPPORT-DETECTED together with TU-NOT-REJECT -- did NOT occur; this is a different combination. Reported as three statistics side by side with no mechanism offered, per DR-A2b's status clause.

anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: The z statistic has a large atom at z = 1 (every prime N): measured mass 0.0481287 in the treatment, 0.0473833 in the enlarged null, 0.0474407 in the support-matched null, 0.0 in the ENC-A contamination source.
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.note: Both KS implementations evaluate the supremum only at distinct pooled z values using counts <= t, i.e. at right-continuous ECDF steps, never inside a tie. A supremum evaluated mid-tie would report a spurious statistic of the order of the atom mass itself, roughly ten times the true value. Recorded because the contract's ties_and_atoms_caveat requires the tie structure to be reported and because it is the failure mode this statistic is most exposed to.

anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: The N-BIG rejection sampler accepted 1046528 of 1136180 attempts, rate 0.9210935. The support-matched sampler accepted 130816 of 261981 pair draws, rate 0.4993339 against the derived 0.5000079, with 4 accepted draws carrying Legendre symbol 0.
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.note: Both match their derived rates (X/2^32 = 0.9210875 and (p+1)/2p = 0.5000079). The samplers are behaving as specified; recorded as an audit trail, not as an anomaly.

anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.observation: The ARM 3 detection-floor diagnostic fires at eps = 0.01 (D_floor = 0.006375367, barely above the 0.006373415 threshold) and does not fire at eps = 0.005 (D_floor = 0.003929183).
anomalies_and_unexpected_observations.note: The firing point at eps = 0.01 exceeds the threshold by 2e-6, i.e. it sits essentially ON the threshold. A six-point grid bounds the floor only to within a grid step and the contamination direction is ENC-A smoothness, one particular alternative. ZERO decision weight in every rule.
